row.notes: (grid, a, b, fn, q): bilinear interpolation, not a for-each: evaluates fn(cell, a, b) on up to four corner cells of grid+0x10 (dims +0xb0/+0xb8; indices q+0x10/+0x18/+0x20/+0x28/+0x30), skipping duplicate corners, then lerps by q[1] with axis table grid+0x68 (q+0x20/+0x28) and by q[0] with grid+0x38 (q+0x10/+0x18).
